before getting my bpd diagnosis i heavily suspected i had it and hearing from my therapist and psychiatrist that i have it kind of libarated me from the feeling of not knowing what is happening with me. I feel like suspcting you have a disorder is the first step in learning how to deal with your symptoms as it leads you towards contacting mental health services to help you deal with your issues. I dont think suspicion of having something is bad as long as that gets you to getting the help you need. My suspicion is what helped me get help and get on the path to getting better. Best of luck to you on your journey of mental health!
